title: Bomb threat alerts Bohol schools on World Teachers’ Day
summary: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — A bomb threat against three universities in Bohol circulated online Monday, prompting security inspections and the suspension of classes at Bohol Island State University…

blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — A bomb threat against three universities in Bohol circulated online Monday, prompting security inspections and the suspension of classes at Bohol Island State University (BISU) as the province marked World Teachers’ Day. The anonymous post named Holy Name University (HNU), University of Bohol (UB), and BISU. Tagbilaran City Mayor Jane Yap
